settings.title: Multica Bridge Settings
settings.subtitle: AstrBot × Multica · connection & chat filters · saved and hot-reloaded automatically
settings.footer: AstrBot Multica Bridge · every change is saved and applied immediately

conn.title: Connection
conn.desc: Multica API endpoint and target workspace / project
conn.enabledHint: The plugin stops responding completely when disabled
conn.apiUrlHint: Cloud: https://multica.ai. For self-hosting, enter your server URL.
conn.tokenHint: Generated in the Multica console; masked when returned to the UI
conn.clearConfirm: Clear the saved Token? This will disconnect Multica.
conn.workspaceIdHint: Leave blank only when one workspace is available; otherwise load and select one.
conn.projectIdHint: New issues are created in this project by default

work.title: Work mode
work.desc: Enter with /multica, exit with /multica exit. Each group or private chat has its own mode.
work.enabledHint: Disabling pauses forwarding; /multica exit remains available.
work.agentHint: A single agent is selected automatically. Choose by number in chat if there are several.
work.note: Only the starter’s text is forwarded in work mode. Other members keep using AstrBot. Work replies remain visible to the group.
work.exit: Restore the ordinary bot; remote tasks continue
work.new: Start a new Chat and keep the old one
work.stop: Stop execution and stay in work mode

nl.title: Natural language control
nl.desc: Messages containing the keyword are parsed automatically — no slash command needed
nl.enabledHint: When off, only /multica commands are handled
nl.keywordHint: Intent recognition runs only when the message contains this keyword (case-insensitive). Default: multica
nl.llmHint: Local rules run first; complex sentences can fall back to the current AstrBot LLM
nl.note: Enter work mode naturally, query the inbox, or draft an Issue. Exit with /multica exit; ordinary work text is forwarded directly.

perm.note: Commands are available to everyone by default; the access list controls eligibility. Remove any old admin-only override in AstrBot Command Management if needed.

cmd.title: Commands
cmd.desc: Send these commands in any allowed group or private chat
cmd.tree: Enter or resume work mode in this window
cmd.status: View the current mode and execution status
cmd.projList: List projects in the current workspace
cmd.nl: Natural language control (message contains the keyword)

test.title: Connection test
test.desc: Verify Multica API reachability and token validity

ui.title: Multica workspace
ui.subtitle: Connect your agents. Keep work moving in your everyday chat.
ui.heroText: Send /multica once, then talk directly to your agent. Discuss, follow up and move work forward in one conversation.
ui.copyHint: Copy a command, then send it in QQ.
ui.demoQuestion: Take a look at this project. Start with a plan.
ui.demoAnswer: Let us clarify the goal, then decide the next step together.
ui.checkHint: Your saved connection is retained. Test to verify.
ui.scopeHint: Starter-only forwarding; ordinary chat for everyone else
ui.workSubtitle: Each group and private chat chooses when to start working.
ui.emptyText: Send /multica in a QQ group or private chat to see it here.
ui.sessionNote: Exiting restores the ordinary bot in that window. Tasks already accepted by Multica continue.
ui.credentialsHint: Your saved URL, Token and workspace are retained. Changes save automatically.
ui.tokenHint: Saved Tokens are masked. An empty field keeps the existing Token.
ui.filterHint: Blocklist excludes listed chats. Allowlist permits only listed chats. Unrestricted permits all.
ui.permissionHint: Commands are available to everyone by default; the access list controls eligibility. Remove any old admin-only override in AstrBot Command Management if needed.
ui.tokenOwnerHint: Operations use the configured Token’s permissions. Grant access only to trusted users or chats.
ui.commandHint: No repeated command is needed in work mode. Use these commands to control the conversation.
ui.advanced: Natural-language controls and management in ordinary mode
ui.nlHint: In ordinary mode, enter work mode, query the inbox, or draft an Issue. Issue writes require the author’s confirmation.
ui.nlModelHint: Ordinary mode may use the AstrBot model to parse management requests. Work mode always talks directly to Multica.
ui.managementHint: Advanced: /multica inbox and /multica issue create. Legacy workspace/project commands remain compatible; manage global defaults in Settings.
ui.footer: Connection retained. Work state saved per conversation.
ui.exited: Ordinary bot restored for this conversation
ui.tokenCleared: Token cleared. Enter a new Token.
ui.copied: Command copied. Send it in QQ.
ui.openInAstrBot: Open this workspace from the AstrBot plugin settings.

access.title: Multica access list
access.intro: One UID or full UMO per line. Formats can be mixed; any match grants access. An empty list denies everyone.
access.label: Allowed UIDs or full UMOs
access.uid: This user can use Multica in all group and private chats.
access.private: Only this user’s private chat through 机器人ID is allowed. Group chats are excluded.
access.group: All members of this 机器人ID group can use Multica commands.
access.scope: Only the starter’s text is forwarded in work mode. Other members keep using AstrBot. Work replies remain visible to the group.
access.denial: Users without access receive: 您没有使用Multica的权限，请联系管理员获取使用资格
access.context: Workspace and project are global defaults. Changes pause old bindings; send /multica new in affected chats. Changing workspace clears the old project.
access.optionsLoaded: Options loaded; choose an entry in the input
access.pause_context_changed: Context changed; start a new Chat

picker.autoHint: Select the only available agent when entering
